ticket.autoresp.name: New Ticket Auto-response
ticket.autoresp.description: Autoresponse sent to user, if enabled, on new ticket.

ticket.autoreply.name: New Ticket Auto-reply
ticket.autoreply.description: Canned Auto-reply sent to user on new ticket, based on filter matches. Overwrites "normal" auto-response.

message.autoresp.name: New Message Auto-response
message.autoresp.description: Confirmation sent to user when a new message is appended to an existing ticket.

ticket.notice.name: New Ticket Notice
ticket.notice.description: Notice sent to user, if enabled, on new ticket created by an agent on their behalf (e.g phone calls).

ticket.overlimit.name: Overlimit Notice
ticket.overlimit.description: A one-time notice sent, if enabled, when user has reached the maximum allowed open tickets.

ticket.activity.notice.name: New Activity Notice
ticket.activity.notice.description: Template used to notify collaborators on ticket activity (e.g CC on reply)

ticket.alert.name: New Ticket Alert
ticket.alert.description: Alert sent to agents, if enabled, on new ticket.

message.alert.name: New Message Alert
message.alert.description: Alert sent to agents, if enabled, when user replies to an existing ticket.

note.alert.name: Internal Activity Alert
note.alert.description: Alert sent out to Agents when internal activity such as an internal note or an agent reply is appended to a ticket.

assigned.alert.name: Ticket Assignment Alert
assigned.alert.description: Alert sent to agents on ticket assignment.

transfer.alert.name: Ticket Transfer Alert
transfer.alert.description: Alert sent to agents on ticket transfer.

ticket.overdue.name: Overdue Ticket Alert
ticket.overdue.description: Alert sent to agents on stale or overdue tickets.

task.alert.name: New Task Alert
task.alert.description: Alert sent to agents, if enabled, on new task.

task.activity.notice.name: New Activity Notice
task.activity.notice.description: Template used to notify collaborators on task activity.

task.activity.alert.name: New Activity Alert
task.activity.alert.description: Alert sent to selected agents, if enabled, on new activity.

task.assignment.alert.name: Task Assignment Alert
task.assignment.alert.description: Alert sent to agents on task assignment.

task.transfer.alert.name: Task Transfer Alert
task.transfer.alert.description: Alert sent to agents on task transfer.

task.overdue.alert.name: Overdue Task Alert
task.overdue.alert.description: Alert sent to agents on stale or overdue task.
